visualRisks.description: The house at row 5, column 6 is isolated and not connected to any road or dock. This could make it difficult for players to access the house.
visualRisks.suggestion: Connect the house to a road or dock.

visualRisks.description: The lighthouse at row 1, column 2 is not easily accessible from the main roads. Players might find it hard to reach this landmark.
visualRisks.suggestion: Place the lighthouse closer to a major road for better accessibility.

navigationRisks.description: There are several dead ends in the district, such as at row 8, column 10 and row 9, column 12. Players might get stuck or confused.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Ensure there is a clear path from one part of the district to another.

navigationRisks.description: The route includes a loop starting at row 3, column 15 and ending at row 9, column 40. This could confuse players who might get stuck in an endless loop.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Remove or modify the loop to create a more linear path.
